remaining_cautions.evidence_context: APD6 AP03088 stores a 32-aa mature sequence matching the C-terminal segment of the primary sequence, while the paper also reports a longer gene-derived sequence and lantibiotic-like mass/processing context. Preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized.

Seven supplementary_original .bin files were opened/typed as Frontiers article/research-topic HTML, NCBI BLAST HTML, or unrelated reference landing pages; no local spreadsheet/PDF supplement table was available or needed for Table 1/MIC50/mechanism repair.
No direct hemolysis, mammalian cytotoxicity, or in vivo toxicity assay was found. The primary discussion frames in vivo toxicity as future work, so no toxicity value is invented.
Time-kill, SEM, and TEM support lysis/membrane/cellular damage, but the paper states the molecular mechanism remains unknown and future assays are needed.
